spans.s: See √ स्रेक्.
(also written श्रेक्, सेक्, स्वेक्) cl. 1. Ā. स्रेकते, to go, move, Dhātup. iv, 8.
or श्रेडी or श्रेढी f. (in the vernaculars शेडि; cf. श्रेणि) a partic. numerical notation or progression of figures (in arithm.), Col.
or श्रेडी or श्रेढी f. (in the vernaculars शेडि; cf. श्रेणि) a partic. numerical notation or progression of figures (in arithm.), Col.
or श्रेडी or श्रेढी f. (in the vernaculars शेडि; cf. श्रेणि) a partic. numerical notation or progression of figures (in arithm.), Col.
(L. also m.; according to Uṇ. iv, 51, fr. √ श्रि; connected with श्रेटी above) a line, row, range, series, succession, troop, flock, multitude, number, RV. &c. &c.
a swarm (of bees), Śiś.
a company of artisans following the same business, a guild or association of traders dealing in the same articles, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a bucket, watering-pot, L.
the fore or upper part of anything, L.
Sanseviera Roxburghiana, L.
a line, row &c. (= श्रेणि), Mn.; MBh. &c.
श्रेणि—कृत mfn. = श्रेणीकृ˚, Pāṇ., Sch.
श्रेणी—कृत mfn. made into a row, forming rows or lines, MBh. (cf. श्रेणि-कृ˚).
श्रे॑णि—दत् (श्रे॑णि-), mfn. one whose teeth form a row, RV.
श्रेणि—बद्ध mfn. bound into a row, forming a row, MBh.
श्रेणि—मत् mfn. having a number of followers, presiding over an association or guild, ib.
श्रेणि—श॑स् ind. in rows or lines or troops or flocks, RV.
श्रेणि—स्थान n. ‘social state’, N. of the first three stages in the life of an Ārya (cf. आश्रम), MBh. xii, 8917.
a front-tooth, Gal.
N. of a king (= बिम्बिसार), HPariś.
See next.
a kind of metre (= श्येणिका), Col.
a tent, W.
श्रेणिक—पुराण n. N. of wk.
श्रेणी—धर्म m. pl. the customs of trades or guilds, Mn. viii, 41.
श्रेणी—बन्ध m. the formation of a row or line, Ragh.
श्रेणी—भूत mfn. being i.e. forming a row or rows, Megh.
N. of a king (= श्रेणिक), Buddh.
= बिम्बि-सार, ib.
(cf. श्रेटी &c.) any set or succession of distinct things, W.
(in arithm.) progression
sequence, ib.
श्रेधी—फल n. the sum of a progression, MW.
श्रेधी—व्यवहार m. the ascertainment or determination of progressions, ib.
one who has recourse to (gen.), MBh. (v.l. आ-श्रेतृ).
distinction, superiority, MaitrS.; Br.

(either compar. of श्री, or rather accord. to native authorities of श्री-मत् or प्रशस्य; cf. Gk. κρείων) more splendid or beautiful, more excellent or distinguished, superior, preferable, better, better than (with abl. or with न See below), RV. &c. &c.
most excellent, best, MBh. iii, 1256
propitious, well disposed to (gen.), ib. i, 3020
auspicious, fortunate, conducive to welfare or prosperity, Kāv.; Hit.; MārkP.
N. of the second Muhūrta
of the third month (accord. to a partic. reckoning)
(with Jainas) N. of the 11th Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī, L.
(अस्), n. the better state, the better fortune or condition (sometimes used when the subject of a sentence would seem to require the masc. form), AV.; TS.; Br.; Kauś.
good (as opp. to ‘evil’), welfare, bliss, fortune, happiness, KaṭhUp.; MBh. &c.
the bliss of final emancipation, felicity (see श्रेयः-परिश्राम, col. 3)
better, rather, rather than (used like वरम् [q.v.] with न; e.g. श्रेयो मृतं न जीवितम्, ‘better is death and not life’ or ‘rather than life’, or ‘death is better than life’), MBh.; R. &c.
= धर्म, L.
N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
N. of various plants (accord. to L. Terminalia Chebula or Citrina; Clypea Hernandifolia; Scindapsus Officinalis; = रास्ना, अम्बष्ठा and प्रियङ्गु), Car.; Bhpr. &c.
N. of a deity of the Bodhi tree, Lalit.
श्रे॑यस्—कर (श्रे॑यस्-), mf(ई)n. making better or superior, VS.
causing or securing fortune, conducive to happiness or prosperity, salutary, wholesome, Mn.; MBh. &c.
श्रेयस्—कर—तर mfn. more efficacious for securing happiness, Mn. xii, 84; 86
श्रेयस्—कर—भाष्य n. N. of wk.
श्रेयस्—काम mf(आ)n. desirous of welfare or prosperity, MBh.; BhP.
श्रेयस्—काम—ता f. desirous of causing happiness or rendering happy, MBh.
श्रेयस्—कृत् mfn. = -कर, BhP.
श्रेयस्—तर mfn. very much better, MW.
श्रेयस्—त्व n. betterness, superiority, Mn. x, 66.
in comp. for श्रेयस्.
श्रे॑यः—केत (श्रे॑यः-), mfn. striving after excellence or superiority, AV.
श्रेयः—परिश्राम m. toiling after final emancipation, BhP.
welfare, happiness, bliss (mostly ifc.; cf. अहं-, निः-, श्वः-श्र्˚).
or श्रेयसी-तरा, f. a more excellent woman, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 45.
or श्रेयसी-तरा, f. a more excellent woman, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 45.
N. of the 11th Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī, L.
in comp. for श्रेयस्.
श्रेयो—ऽभिकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. desiring bliss or welfare, Mn. iv, 91.
श्रेयो—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of bliss, excellent, best, ŚārṅgS.
श्रेयो—ऽर्थिन् mfn. desiring felicity or bliss, Śāntiś.
desirous of good, ambitious, W.
mf(आ)n. most splendid or beautiful, most beautiful of or among (with gen.), RV.; AV.; R.
most excellent, best, first, chief (n. ‘the best or chief thing’), best of or among or in respect of or in (with gen. loc., or comp.), RV. &c. &c.
better, more, distinguished, superior, better than (abl. or gen.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
most auspicious or salutary, VarBṛS.
oldest, senior, W.
a king, L.
a Brāhman, L.
N. of Viṣṇu or Kubera, L.
N. of a king, Buddh.
cow's milk, L.
copper, L.
(आ), f. an excellent woman, MW.
Hibiscus Mutabilis, L. (prob. w.r. for लक्ष्मी-श्र्˚)
a kind of root resembling ginger, L.
श्रेष्ठ—काष्ठ m. Tectona Grandis, L.
श्रेष्ठ—काष्ठ n. the main pillar of a house, W.
श्रे॑ष्ठ—तम (श्रे॑ष्ठ-), mfn. the very best, most excellent, RV. &c. &c.
श्रे॑ष्ठ—तमा (आ), f. holy basil, L.
श्रेष्ठ—तर mfn. more excellent, better than (abl.), MBh.
श्रेष्ठ—तस् ind. according to excellence or superiority, Lāṭy.
श्रेष्ठ—ता f. (AitBr.; Mn. &c.) betterness, eminence, excellence, superiority.
श्रेष्ठ—त्व n. (Suśr.) betterness, eminence, excellence, superiority.
श्रेष्ठ—पाल m. N. of a king, Buddh.
श्रेष्ठ—भाज् mfn. ‘possessing the best’, = श्रेष्ठ, best, excellent, MBh.
श्रेष्ठ—यज्ञ m. the best or chief sacrifice, AitBr.
श्रेष्ठ—यान n. (with Buddhists) the best or chief vehicle, Vajracch.
श्रे॑ष्ठ—वर्चस् (श्रे॑ष्ठ-), mfn. having most excellent vigour or energy or glory, RV.
श्रेष्ठ—वाच् mfn. pre-eminent in speech, eloquent, R.
श्रेष्ठ—शाक n. a kind of excellent potherb (cf. वर-पोत), L.
श्रे॑ष्ठ—शोचिस् (श्रे॑ष्ठ-), mfn. having the best splendour, most brilliant, RV.
श्रेष्ठ—सामन् n. the best or chief Sāman, PañcavBr.
श्रेष्ठ—सेन m. N. of a king, Rājat.
श्रेष्ठ—स्था mfn. (nom. -स्थास्) fit for or belonging to the best, TāṇḍBr.
descended from an excellent family, Mālatīm.
the fruit of Garcinia Cambogia, L.
the best period or stage of a Brāhman's life, one who is in the best period, a householder, L.

श्रेष्˚ठिक See भूरि-श्र्˚.
having the best, best, chief, W.
a distinguished man, a person of rank or authority, AitBr.; ŚāṅkhBr.; KauṣUp.
a warrior of high rank, Jātakam.
an eminent artisan, the head or chief of an association following the same trade or industry, the president or foreman of a guild (also f(इनी). a female artisan &c.), Hariv.; Kāv.; VarBṛS. &c.
See अ-श्रेष्म॑न्.
resembling oleander, TBr.
